Name: Marcy from Amphibia
Author: Hvzel
Description:
[center]﻿[img]https://imgur.com/wNNUAD0.gif[/img]

[size=5]"Oh my gosh! Who are these cuties? Are they your surrogate frog family? Did they adopt you and take you in? Oh, I love the found family trope!" - Marcy

[/size][size=3]So I've enjoyed Amphibia for a long while, and I also wanted to learn how to make mods for Stardew Valley! So why not mix them together and add my favorite nerdy, crossbow wielding, frog loving character!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/wmxDSce.png[/img]﻿

[list]
[*]Adds Marcy, a teen NPC, along with a place for her to live!
[*]Her Tent is near the museum!
[*]Her birthday is on the 20th of spring!
[*]She also is at all events!
[*]Loves: Aquamarine, Ruby, Pizza, Amphibian Fossil
[*]Likes: Skeletal Tail, Nautilus Fossil, Life Elixir
[*]Neutral: Forageables
[*]Dislikes: Emerald, Tulip, Pumpkin Pie
[*]Hated: Trash (duh), Seafoam Pudding, Coleslaw
[*]She currently only has one event, being a 2 heart event (Required you to have the Amphibian Fossil in your inventory, have 2 hearts and have it be a friday.)
[size=3]
[/size][/list][/size][size=3]
Her gift's are subject to change, as on quite a few I'm not sure if I like them.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/66UstBg.png[/img]
